comparison.objective: Seat both ends of a quick-release wheel axle and close the lever in the safe direction.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual axle/dropout alignment, insertion, and over-centre latch operation.
comparison.success_condition: Both axle ends fully seated and lever closed along/rearward of fork; premature closure or closure while unseated invalidates success.
comparison.reason: Although it includes precision insertion and latching, it tests assembly seating rather than controlled notch fracture and recovery of released tangs.
